data.why: The frontend picks image/model directories from the repo's own data/ and models/ folders via dropdowns (os.listdir), and the repo already bundles data/demo (annotations.json, sample_metadata.csv, raw camera-trap images, MegaDetector boxes) and models/demo_model (eval results, errors, uncertain predictions), so nothing needs to be staged for browser upload.

goals: Annotate detected animals in camera-trap images with age and sex classes using the demo image set
Review a trained model's overall accuracy, precision, recall, and F1, broken down by stratum
Inspect the class distribution and confusion matrix for an evaluation run
Browse misclassified images to spot patterns in the model's errors
Review images where the model's predictions were flagged as uncertain, and compare against the confidence threshold

review.summary: The evaluation half of the tree is accurate, well-grounded in the screens, and sensibly split into overall metrics, subgroups, runs, training specs, errors and uncertain images, with all four features replayed. But the tool's first purpose, labelling detected animals with user-defined age/sex classes, is reduced to opening a fully labelled folder, so the annotation tasks and features need to be added (ideally by staging an unlabelled collection) before filing.
